statement: npm run analyze:formation-release-phases -- <report-dir> (scripts/checks/analyze-formation-release-phases.js) prints, per generation and cohort member of a five-node formation certification run, the timeline W (capture) -> handoff observed -> barrier release -> READY with deltas and the typed NODE_PHASE per node, and carries the closure analyzer's classification, closure verdict, failure reasons and completionMs unchanged: the view reuses the analyzer's exported functions (FORMATION_LOG_EVIDENCE) and mints no verdict of its own; READY is only the owner's recorded readyNodeIds and nothing derives ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage; the npm script is registered in package.json and the command listing. Proven deterministically on immutable report excerpts: red on HEAD (script absent), green after; analyzer classification unchanged as the control.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The phase view reuses the closure analyzer's exported functions and copies its classification, closure, failure reasons and completionMs; it mints no verdict of its own and changes no analyzer decision.
READY in the timeline is only the owner's recorded readyNodeIds; nothing derives ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
The witness runs on immutable report excerpts; no cloud command is part of the proof.
Proof is a deterministic witness red on HEAD (1/7) and green after (7/7) with analyzer-classification-unchanged as the control that must stay green.
